caption: The drawing shows a brass or bronze-colored metal pot with three legs and a long handle extending from the upper right side. The pot is cylindrical in shape, with an open top and a smooth surface. The three legs are spread apart for stability, and they are attached at the base of the pot, angling outward. The handle is thin and tapers to a point, and it appears to be made of the same metal as the pot. The pot and its handle are shaded to indicate light and shadow, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance. The entire composition is centered on a cream-colored background with a thin, red rectangular border framing the image. In the lower right corner, there is a small line drawing of the same pot showing its dimensions, labeled with "18 in" for the length including the handle and "6 in" for the height. At the bottom left, there is a text label that reads "DEL. 1561 James M. Lawton Gordon K. Saltar."
title: Pot with Legs
